summary_en: NISSO GROUP updates its capital cost and share price management policy as part of the 4th Medium-Term Business Plan announced in October 2024. The company conducted analysis and evaluation of the previously disclosed approach and has revised the content accordingly.
title_en: Notice regarding updates to initiatives for management conscious of cost of capital and share prices
translation_en_brief: On October 15, 2026, NISSO GROUP announced an update to its policy on management conscious of cost of capital and share prices, which was initially disclosed as part of the 4th Medium-Term Business Plan announced on October 15, 2024. The board of directors has reviewed and evaluated the current status and revised the previously disclosed approach accordingly. Specific details regarding the updated initiatives are provided in the attached material.
